Data Scientist, Growth
Lumen Fields
Austin, TX

Lumen Fields sells farm sensors. The growth team owns pricing experiments and our go-to-market analytics. We go above and beyond to make results easy to read.

Must have:
- Python, R and SQL for analysis
- Statistics and A/B testing experience
- Machine learning with scikit-style tooling in pandas and NumPy
- Ability to present results to non-technical teams

Nice-to-have:
- C or C++ for embedded data collection
- Experience with Looker
- Spark

Hybrid: two days a week in our Austin office.
